title: Patch: every Meditative card drawn as what it is: a scene of its own for each, richer the rarer
notes: Meditative's picture pass (#3330, #3331's foundation). Every Meditative entry, its 30 tokens included, draws from a scene recipe of its own, from a brief per card, in Meditative's ink-wash look, base and Radiant (R3401000): a Common one clear subject in the mist, a Rare its props, an Epic a scene with a foreground, a middle and a background, a Legendary or Mythic every layer, and every picture one red seal. Each person Unit is a figure dressed as who it is, 21 Units that are no person are drawn as a beast, a plant, a machine, a sprite, a totem or a building of the scene kit, the two full-art cards whose motions move props mark the placements that move, and the figure kit and the scene kit grow by the parts the briefs name. All 132 entries clear their rarity's detail floor and leave the short list, whose cap falls from 337 to 205 (R3331001). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Every Meditative card drawn as a scene
changes: Every Meditative card and token now shows an ink-wash scene of its own, more detailed the rarer it is: its Units as the characters they are, its Spells as real places and moments.
